optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Change Management Specialist, Mobile App Services
professionalSummary: Seasoned change management professional with a year of experience overseeing fortnightly releases of a consumer banking mobile app across iOS and Android. Demonstrated expertise in preparing comprehensive change requests, coordinating pre‑freeze activities with engineering and QA squads, recording board decisions, and delivering post‑release summaries to operations leadership.
experienceHighlights: Prepared and quality‑checked eleven change requests for fortnightly releases, ensuring rollback plans, test evidence, and ownership were documented before board submission.
Recorded change advisory board decisions in the change tool and maintained an up‑to‑date release calendar, publishing go/no‑go outcomes to squads.
Led pre‑freeze checklists with four app squads and QA, chasing open items and escalating unresolved issues to the operations manager two days before freeze.
Authored post‑release summaries detailing incidents, rollbacks, and carry‑over items, reviewed by the operations manager.
Managed end‑to‑end change management responsibilities for the mobile release train over approximately one year.
projectsAndWorkSamples: An anonymised change‑request pack for a single release, including request list, rollback plans, test‑evidence links, board decision record, and post‑release summary with audit trail from the change tool.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample confirm the candidate’s experience in change request preparation, board record keeping, pre‑freeze coordination, and post‑release reporting for a mobile app release train. They do not provide evidence of documenting known limitations or hand‑over conditions for each release cycle.

role.roleTitle: Change Management Specialist, Mobile App Services

evidence.text: Prepared change requests for eleven fortnightly releases of the banking app, checking each request for a rollback plan, linked test evidence and a named owner before submission to the change advisory board.

Work sample: an anonymised change-request pack for one release (request list, rollback plans, test-evidence links, board decision record) and the post-release summary, with the change tool's audit history as a verification trail.
Recorded change advisory board decisions in the change tool and kept the release calendar current; the board chair took the go/no-go decision and I published the outcome to the squads.
Ran the pre-freeze checklist with the four app squads and QA, chasing open items and escalating unresolved ones to the operations manager two days before each freeze.
Wrote the post-release summary for each cycle, listing incidents, any rollback and the open items carried into the next cycle, which the operations manager reviewed.
